questions.question: How many Bytes are stored by 'Long' Data type in C# .net?
questions.explanation: 'Long' is the data type keyword used for storing data of unlimited length so by definition its size is always maximum i.e 8.

questions.question: Choose ".NET class" name from which data type "UInt" is derived?
questions.explanation:
By Definition class assigned to

              i) System.Int16 = short.

              ii) System.UInt32 = UInt.

              iii) System.UInt64 = ULong.

              iv) System.UInt16 = UShort.

questions.question: Arrange the following data type in order of increasing magnitude sbyte, short, long, int.
Which data type should be more preferred for storing a simple number like 35 to improve execution speed of a program?
questions.explanation: Wider data type like int, long takes more time for manipulation of a program.

questions.question: Which Conversion function of 'Convert.TOInt32()' and 'Int32.Parse()' is efficient?
questions.code:
i) Int32.Parse() is only used for strings and throws argument exception for null string
ii) Convert.Int32() used for data types and returns directly '0' for null string
questions.explanation: Convenient for every data type so mostly preferred.
